change.description: Add official GPT-6 Astra/Sol/Luna pricing and model discovery, plus nullable exact upstream cache-write usage in invocation APIs and durable records.
change.release_unit_description: Formal GPT-6 Astra, Sol, and Luna pricing, usage accounting, API, and durable-state support.

planned.reasoning: The additive nullable API field is nonbreaking, while persisted exact usage requires preserving a new column through future writes and older Minor binaries cannot preserve it when re-archiving.

scope_drift.description: No compatibility scope drift from the approved GPT-6 and exact cache-write usage plan.

current.reasoning: Public API impact remains patch because reportedCacheWriteTokens is nullable and additive. Persistent state is minor because the candidate reads prior schemas and archives, but older same-Minor binaries cannot preserve the new column on re-archive; release impact is the higher of the two.

verified.reasoning: Automated migration, archive compatibility, and API tests validate additive same-Major reads and the documented write-forward compatibility boundary; public API remains nonbreaking. The release unit therefore takes persistent-state minor impact.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Existing API consumers within the current Major; reportedCacheWriteTokens is nullable and omitted or NULL for older records.

persistent_state.state_description: SQLite invocation rows, future invocation archives, and repo-managed pricing catalog seeds.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: Supported earlier 0.2.x repository-managed state including pre-column schema and archive layouts; direct Major skips are not supported.
